CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, where the issuer is named 'GENERAL MTRS CO'. The denominator is the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count (October 9, 2026), the same count used in the marketcap lens.
